shots.note: L5 'and now they finally look like they're slowly fading,' (8.16-10.56) is a results line, so S5+S6 (7.93-10.47 = 2.54 s) become the B/A split this video was missing. Vertical half/half: left KN08_before_day, right KN07_after_day, face not cropped, labels 'BEFORE' / 'AFTER 2 WEEKS'.

shots.content: Creator spreading cream on her cheek, with the '2% KOJIC ACID NIGHT CREAM' pill.
shots.note: End of L6 + L7 'apply it, lights off, and go to sleep,'. KN04 clip 1.5-5.0 s: massaged in under a warm lamp until fully absorbed, no residue. Application only at night.

shots.content: Hand reaching to switch off the bedside lamp next to the jar.

shots.content: Creator asleep in a dark room, under 'LIGHTS OFF / LET SKIN DO ITS WORK'.
shots.note: L8 'and let your skin do its work.' Continuation of KN05 into dawn. Keep the super.
